mol_from_ccd_cif: create an RDKit Mol object from a CCD mmCIF data block with optional force parse and hydrogen removal
mol_to_ccd_cif: build a CCD-like mmCIF data block from an RDKit Mol object with optional hydrogen inclusion
parse_atom_data: parse atom names, types, charges, and leaving flags from an mmCIF molecule data block
parse_bond_data: parse bond begin atoms, end atoms, bond types, and aromatic flags from an mmCIF molecule
get_random_conformer: generate a random 3D conformer for an RDKit Mol using the ETKDGv3 stochastic embedding method
